no-restricted-syntax.message: Use apiClient instead of raw fetch('/api…'). Raw fetch bypasses the configured base URL and auth headers and 404s in split-origin deploys.
Use apiClient instead of raw fetch(`/api…`). Raw fetch bypasses the configured base URL and auth headers and 404s in split-origin deploys.
